tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: List the Indian exams whose photo and signature upload rules Docexp has verified against the official notification.

tools.name: get_exam_photo_spec
tools.description: Official photo and signature upload rules (KB limits, dimensions, format) for an Indian exam, with the verbatim notification sentences they come from, the source URL and the date checked.

tools.name: get_passport_photo_size
tools.description: Official passport or visa photo size for a country (US passport, US visa, Canada passport, UK passport), quoted from the issuing government page, with the source URL and the date checked.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_exams, get_exam_photo_spec, get_passport_photo_size · Public sink: list_exams, get_exam_photo_spec · Destructive: get_exam_photo_spec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_exams, get_exam_photo_spec, get_passport_photo_size · Public sink: list_exams, get_exam_photo_spec · Destructive: get_exam_photo_spec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
